repos.name: large
repos.notes: Fantomas.FCS runs 'build.fsx -p Init' during restore, which fails under MSBuild (fsi nuget resolution); the script runs it up front outside MSBuild, and the restore target then skips because .deps exists. The repo pins SDK 11.0.100-rc.2, which is not installed, so the script idempotently rewrites the clone's global.json to 10.0.100 with rollForward latestMajor (the clone is dirty by that one file).
